desktop-N128.method: Real IndexedDB version-1 database, v3 checksummed payload, cooperative validation/restore/cache, then actual App Open/Save. Timings include cooperative waits. Typed payload accounting excludes JS/GC/Canvas/browser overhead and is not process RSS. Pixel 7 is emulation, not physical hardware.
